source_description: Native ecoinvent 3.12 cutoff classification metadata, read-only extraction. Exact activity name, reference product and unit identify each entry. Regional classifications are retained only when all nonempty source values agree; conflicting systems are recorded as ambiguous and omitted from classifications. This metadata catalog contains no LCI exchanges, activity codes, UUIDs or database addresses.
source_metadata_hash_method: SHA256 of ASCII JSON with sorted object keys and compact separators over all source metadata rows sorted by name, reference product, unit, location and classifications; projection includes identity, location and sorted CPC/ISIC values only.
